notes.title: Square Word: Summer Edition is now available on Steam (-10%)
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36422902/e847db2ea0ee1e80933ff58dd031eb5d4eabfd85.png[/img]

Hello lovers of calm and puzzle games!

After a very long break, we are releasing a new game on Steam! 
Square Word is a word game focused on Summer!

It's our second word game and we listen all the feedback from the previous episode to make it better (the Christmas edition is not available on Steam but we will reboot it for next Christmas!).

[b]What's in it?[/b]
- 4 Summer themes!
- More than 120 levels from very easy to very hard.
- Two different hint to help you when you are stuck.
- Daily grid with a single 9-letter word to find
- Mini-objectives to complete

Play now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707670/Square_Word_Summer_Edition/

notes.title: Rogue's Choice is now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36422902/a3d6d3f727585abc5548bfde15843c984fccaa48.jpg[/img]
[h2]Hello players!

Cold Coffee Studio and Delight Games are proud to announce the release of our second game book in the DnD Adventures series: Rogue's Choice![/h2]

[b]Play the lovable scoundrel who just wants to enjoy his short time in this dimension![/b]

[b][u]REMINDER[/u]: This story is [u]not[/u] connected to Wizard's Choice, you don't need to have played or finish Wizard to play this new adventure! It's the same world but a different location and story. Some elements may remind you WC while playing it but there are just little connections/winks.[/b]

What's in the menu:
- A longer (and harder) story divided in 22 chapters!
- No more magic for you this time but you have different skills!
- A brand new intro :)
- New backgrounds, new FX, new songs, colors and everything. We improved Wizard UI a lot and those improvements will also come to WC in the upcoming day (after a big round of tests and adaptations).
- New menu to see the other gamebooks available in the series!
- We did a lot of changes according to the feedback we received in WC Steam reviews like
[list]
[*] Shorter screen transitions
[*] Better "Dark screen filter"
[*] Musics also transition between scenes, they don't cut anymore.
[*] Some of you find WC to easy, try this one!
[*] Size of buttons now increases with size of text, it's easier to read but also easier to click!
[*] We turned all Ressources into Resources!
[/list]

We hope that you will really like this new story hand crafted by Delight Games and me!
Join us on Twitter!
[url=https://twitter.com/DelightGames]https://twitter.com/DelightGames[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/coldcoffeegames]https://twitter.com/coldcoffeegames[/url]

notes.title: My Jigsaw Adventure: A Lost Story is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37721981/520b5ba05f4683812da5c674c321c863146a4a05.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37721981/12cdd3f51a0615575a86936c6b509b74df6bca07.png[/img]

We're happy to announce that the second episod of the MJA series is now available for you to play! With the My Jigsaw Adventures series, we aimed to bring jigsaw puzzle games to a new era. We've started this journey a while ago with Roads of Life and pursue it today, with the release of [b]A Lost Story[/b]. If you enjoyed Roads of Life, we're certain you'll have a great time playing A Lost Story!

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297230/My_Jigsaw_Adventures__A_Lost_Story/][u]>>> A LOST STORY STEAM PAGE <<<[/u][/url][/h3]

With MJA episod 2, we've decided to challenge ourselves once again and offer even more features. Thanks to the wonderful reviews and feedbacks we received, we were able to take A Lost Story further. You will enjoy - if you dare! - 500 and 1000 pieces puzzles, and a special mode for challenges.

[previewyoutube=NjTm4QWSzso;full][/previewyoutube]

This time, we've partnered with Jeremy Adams, an environment artist from the USA,  who is creating amazing artworks. If you're curious, please have a look at his gallery. It's 100% worth it! 
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.artstation.com/jeremy_adams]Jeremy's work on artstation[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/jeremyadams.ink/]Jeremy's instagram [/url]
[/list]

The story has been imagined and written by Marco Nathaniel Nappo.

Once again, we are proud of what we've achieved and can't be thankful enough to all the people who helped us. We would like to address special thanks to the passionate testers and translators without whom nothing would have been possible. 

We hope A Lost Story will be as pleasant as we aimed for it to be. Enjoy the ride!

Sincerely,
Your friends from CCS

notes.title: New Update: 07.04.2020
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, we hope you've enjoyed [i]Roads of Life[/i] so far!

It's been a very busy week for us. :) Since the release, we've collected very interesting feedback. This led us to rework some of the features and fix issues that were not working perfectly.

[u][b]So what's been updated?[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Spanish version works fine

[*] You now have to use the right click to move the puzzling table. The left click was used before, which led players to accidentally drag the table instead of dragging pieces.

[*] You can now resize the window in window mode

[*] New musics have been implemented

[*] We fixed several typos in the french version
[/list]


Thank you to all the players who used some of their playtime to gather suggestions and reports. 


Have fun,
The CCS Team

notes.title: My Jigsaw Adventures: Roads of Life is now live!
notes.content:
[h1]Here we are![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36690185/d380cf01474cd4a61625bd677faf692007095c29.png[/img]

After months of development and way too much cups of coffee, [i][b]My Jigsaw Adventures: Roads of Life[/b][/i] is finally ready to be played! We’ve worked a great deal in order to provide the most complete set of features and guarantee the best puzzling experience. Releasing yet another game to Steam is particularly exciting, for the passionate players that we are.

[i][u]Special note:[/u] we decided to apply a [b]-10% discount[/b] until April 8th, to support - in our own way - people who are stuck at home due to the COVID-19 epidemy. We sincerely hope the passion we put in developing this game will bring joy and entertainment to jigsaw puzzle and indie game fans around the world.[/i]

- - - - -

With the [i][b]My Jigsaw Adventures[/b][/i] series, we aim to bring jigsaw puzzle games to a new era. Starting today, with [i][b]Roads of Life[/b][/i].

[previewyoutube=Ld5yy0C2ddk;full][/previewyoutube]

We wanted to create something fundamentally different and bring a breath of fresh air to digital jigsaw games. What could we possibly do that had not already been done? New theme? Not enough. New game modes? Too easy! So we asked ourselves: What is the missing piece to turn jigsaw puzzles into beautiful journeys? Which magical ingredient could make our games unique?

[list]
[*][b]The narrative -[/b] Jigsaw puzzle games usually don’t have any other end than their own completion. By adding a narrative experience, we’re aiming to instill a brand new dimension to jigsaws and make them even more fascinating. To complete a jigsaw in Roads of Life is to turn a page, unlock a new stage and discover the next chapter of an incredible story![/list]
[list]
[*][b]The art - [/b]By collaborating with concept artists, we're ensuring spirit continuity along the story, high quality and exclusive jigsaw puzzles. For [i]Roads of Life[/i], we worked with [b]Bogdan Antoci[/b], a concept artist and illustrator from Romania. (Check out his gallery on [url=https://www.artstation.com/bogdanantoci]artstation[/url] or [url=https://www.instagram.com/bogdanantoci.art/]instagram[/url])[/list]


[h1]Thank you![/h1]

We want to thank all the alpha testers who helped improving the game; let it be missing features or bugs hidden at the bend of a road. We're also addressing our eternal gratitude to the translation crew, that did an incredible job: [i]Roads of Life[/i] is available in 6 different languages (english, french, spanish, german, russian and ukrainian)!

We hope you will enjoy hours of pure evasion while playing Roads of Life. Let your mind journey through magical lands, while you are completing beautiful jigsaws...

Sincerely,
Your friends from CCS
